analysis_window: Requested duration in actual unwrapped board-clock seconds after recorded motion-start STATE, without sample-count duration estimates.
episode_bounds: Entry lies between previous and first selected mode sample; exit between last and next. Gaps >30ms split contiguous episodes.
actuation_caveat: Commanded trajectory acceleration, not physical motor acceleration. Interval-average jerk fractions are duration weighted and use the trial recorded jmax.
camera_caveat: Current working anchor retained; 19ms previously frozen effective delay is descriptive only; no camera map applied.

camera.source_clock_mapping: native board plus per-run 1st percentile serial-receipt offset; camera t is host-read, not exposure

firmware_provenance.source: Explicit release-manifest association, matched to INFO version; not a device hash readback.

settled_hanging.window: last 1 actual board-clock second ending at recorded motion-start STATE

camera.clock_note: Host-read source t, mapped using unchanged per-run lower-envelope receipt convention; no exposure claim.
